text: In human iPSC-derived neuron/astrocyte co-cultures, ApoE4/4 (AD donor) neurons had larger and more numerous LysoTracker-labelled lysosomes than ApoE3/3 (normal-aging donor) neurons. Average area was 163.5 vs 90.4 μm2, and 18.4% vs 1.6% of neurons had more than 10 lysosomes per cell (reported: 163.5 μm2 vs 90.4 μm2).
description: Human iPSC-derived cortical neurons co-cultured with iPSC-derived astrocytes. Lines came from an ApoE4/4 AD subject and an ApoE3/3 normal-aging subject and are not isogenic. Cells were stained with LysoTracker red plus MAP2/DAPI and imaged by confocal microscopy. Lysosomes of 60-90 MAP2+ neurons were quantified per condition; N = 3-6 per condition. Caveat: measures neurons rather than astrocytes, and lysosome size/number rather than endosomal pH. Genotype is confounded with AD status and donor.

provenance.excerpt: The average size of lysosomes measured by area was 163.5 μm2 in ApoE4+/+ versus 90.4 μm2 in ApoE3+/+ neurons (Fig. 5c, p < 0.00001).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (enlarged, more numerous LysoTracker-positive acidic compartments in human iPSC-derived neurons); size/number, not pH
